svg.title: Kleidos bench meter shunt calibration schematic
svg.desc: Sheet 2 of the Kleidos bench meter's rig: the same parts rewired for the shunt's two-point calibration, with a 100 Ω reference in the board's place, sensed four-wire.

g.text: Offset nulls with K1 open (ROUT:LEAD OPEN,FORC), on each range, before the points and again after them.

g.desc: Offset nulls with K1 open (ROUT:LEAD OPEN,FORC), on each range, before the points and again after them.

g.text: R4: Vishay VPG Y0785100R000T9L, 100 Ω ±0.01 % foil (S102C, ±2 ppm/°C). About 41 mA flows from a 4.1 V cell.

g.desc: R4: Vishay VPG Y0785100R000T9L, 100 Ω ±0.01 % foil (S102C, ±2 ppm/°C). About 41 mA flows from a 4.1 V cell.

g.text: Sheet 1's parts (numbered +100) rewired for the two-point calibration of R100: R4, the reference, in the DUT's place, four-wire

g.desc: Sheet 1's parts (numbered +100) rewired for the two-point calibration of R100: R4, the reference, in the DUT's place, four-wire

g.text: Sheet 1's parts, numbered +100: U101 is U1, R200 is R100, K101 is K1, U104 is U4. R4 is new. RL1 stays wired, held open.

g.desc: Sheet 1's parts, numbered +100: U101 is U1, R200 is R100, K101 is K1, U104 is U4. R4 is new. RL1 stays wired, held open.

g.text: The cell's + (pigtail 2) on VIN+, JP2 off: VBUS no longer reads the cell, it reads R4's top lead.

g.desc: The cell's + (pigtail 2) on VIN+, JP2 off: VBUS no longer reads the cell, it reads R4's top lead.

g.text: Afterwards: R4 out, the VBUS wire and JP2 back, the cell's + back on VBUS, pigtail 3 into the DUT: sheet 1.

g.desc: Afterwards: R4 out, the VBUS wire and JP2 back, the cell's + back on VBUS, pigtail 3 into the DUT: sheet 1.

g.text: The null drifts with thermal EMF in the sense loop: take it again every session, never carry one over.

g.desc: The null drifts with thermal EMF in the sense loop: take it again every session, never carry one over.

g.text: The reference path, the Kelvin sense on R100 and on R4

g.desc: The reference path, the Kelvin sense on R100 and on R4

g.text: Force: pigtail 3, from K1 NC, onto R4's top lead. Sense: the VBUS wire on a separate point of that same lead.

g.desc: Force: pigtail 3, from K1 NC, onto R4's top lead. Sense: the VBUS wire on a separate point of that same lead.

g.text: R4's bottom lead to the INA228's GND with its own wire: the 41 mA return shares no wire with the VBUS sense.

g.desc: R4's bottom lead to the INA228's GND with its own wire: the 41 mA return shares no wire with the VBUS sense.

g.text: Every joint in the reference path screwed: twisted or clipped joints gave ~0.17 Ω and a 7 mV error (2026-11-20).

g.desc: Every joint in the reference path screwed: twisted or clipped joints gave ~0.17 Ω and a 7 mV error (2026-11-20).

g.text: SLEEP profile: 4120 µs conversions, AVG 16. Points in blocks range 0, 1, 1, 0; R100 = V_shunt × R4 / V_ref.

g.desc: SLEEP profile: 4120 µs conversions, AVG 16. Points in blocks range 0, 1, 1, 0; R100 = V_shunt × R4 / V_ref.

g.text: R4's own return to the INA228's GND

g.desc: R4's own return to the INA228's GND
